$comment: The asset store (docs/asset-store.md). Media under these roots with these extensions live in S3, content-addressed; git keeps assets.lock.json. storeUrl is the public, credential-free read URL every clone, CI job and deploy pulls from. It is declared here, not copied from a stack: the production deploy builds the store (infra/asset-store.yaml) to serve at this host and fails if it does not (scripts/deploy-asset-store.sh). bucket null means writers read it from the stack. untracked flips to true at the cutover (npm run assets:migrate -- --untrack) and arms the guard that keeps media out of git. exclude: generated output a push does not pick up unless named. mcpUrl is production's MCP server (the stack's McpServerUrl output), for assets:push --writer mcp (docs/mcp-server.md); KAD_MCP_URL points elsewhere, e.g. staging.
